recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring four male subjects in a tight, circular arrangement, captured from a low-angle perspective. The image utilizes a deep burgundy-to-black duotone color grade with high contrast, framed by a clean white header bar containing lowercase display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of faces pointing toward the center
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on skin
Juxtaposition of organic human forms against a rigid white geometric header
Monochromatic color palette unifying disparate lighting conditions
coreInvariants: White horizontal header bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four faces occupy the quadrants of the square, scaled to fill the frame with minimal background visible.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central void between the four heads acts as the focal point for the radial arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves clockwise around the faces, and settles on the bottom-right subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows between the subjects and the stark white header bar.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast; values are pushed to extremes of black and white with a dominant mid-tone tint.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated 'l' and 'b' ascenders that touch or nearly touch the top edge
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family or style, varied by weight and tracking (tight display vs. airy subtitle).

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Bauhaus or similar rounded geometric
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, friendly but urban lowercase feel
Matches the sturdy, urban editorial aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square photo of four men's faces arranged in a circle, looking down at the camera from a low angle. Apply a high-contrast duotone filter using deep burgundy and black. Add a solid white horizontal bar across the top 15% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large black lowercase sans-serif text in the top left, partially overlapping the white bar. Add small, widely-spaced lowercase sans-serif text in light grey in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly burgundy/black/white?
Is the perspective looking up at the subjects?
Is there a clear white bar at the top?

adjustableVariables: Tint color (e.g., blue-black instead of burgundy-black)
Width of the top header bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for duotone consistency across all four faces
Ensure text does not have serifs
Verify the white bar is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial portrait arrangement + Duotone color grade + White header bar + Lowercase sans-serif typography.
